messages.author: 03082f3d9064040b
messages.subject: tryCatch Problem
parts:
Hello everybody,

i am having an issue with tryCatch using rApache (for a small
statistical web application using the package 'qualityTools') and it
would be very nice, if someone could help me!!

If an error occurs, the R-part of the ErrorFunction is executed, but
the html part is not :

Here is my (simplified) code:

<%
showSink <- function(){
library(qualityTools)

TestData= c(1:7)
# error occurs, because 8 numbers are necessary, try c(1:8) and it
works

setwd('/var/www/data/PCR')
summaryText <- paste ('AndersonPCR', date(), '.txt', sep="-")
sink(summaryText)
x <- pcr(TestData)
sink()
%>
<object data="/data/PCR/<%=summaryText%>" width="500" height="130">
<%
}

printError <- function(e){
setwd('/var/www/data/PCR')
errorText <- paste ('errorPCR' , date(), '.txt', sep="")
sink(errorText)
print("Unfortunalety the following error has occured:")
print(e$message)
sink()
%>
<object data="/data/PCR/<%=errorText%>" width="500" height="130">
<%
}
tryCatch(showSink(), error = printError)
%>


If there is no error, everything works fine (e.g., if TestData is set
to c(1:8)).

I am not very experienced with rApache, so maybe I am not seeing
something obvious, but I would be released, if someone can help me!

Best Regards,
Saramis

messages.author: 25a4f5811cd7d59e
messages.subject: Re: tryCatch Problem
parts:
Hmm...

Not sure why that wouldn't work, but your use of brew tags within the
functions makes me a bit nervous. Consider rewriting your example like
this brew file:

<%
showSink <- function(x){
eval(parse(text=x))
'Works!'
}

printError <- function(e){
paste('OH NO AN ERROR:',e$message)
}
%>
<%=tryCatch(showSink('er()'), error = printError)%>

Jeff

messages.subject: Re: tryCatch Problem
parts:
Sorry, it is me again to the same topic (and thanks for your fast answers, Jeffrey!!):

Something is strange about try and catch in Rapache, which I tried to reconstruct with two simple example errors:

For some errors, the errormessage is printed correctly in the browser (Example 1), but for
other errors the error message is sent to the error log (Example 2):
Example 1 (error message is catched &  shown (as it should) in the browser):
<%
showList <- function(){

print(k)
# of course, k is not defined yet

}
printError <- function(e){
print(e$message)
}
tryCatch(showList(),error=printError)
%>

Example 2 (the error message("unexpected symbol") is not catched and is sent to the error.log file
-> not shown  in the browser, which leads to an 500 internal error in Firefox)
<%
showList <- function(){

no List = 3
#should have been noList=3

}
printError <- function(e){
print(e$message)
}
tryCatch(showList(),error=printError)
%>


Does anyone know, why this happens or know how to get along with this behaviour? ( i am working on a web application with Rapache and some errors are just not catched and the app is crashing in an error case...)

Thanks for your help !!
